title: 领导力 Day 49：讲故事的领导力

questions.question: 用 And / But / Therefore 宣布一次痛苦的架构迁移时，「But」这一段最应该做到什么？
options: 直接宣布迁移的时间表和分工，避免讨论拖慢执行
详细铺陈历史背景和各方案对比，让团队自己得出必须迁移的结论
点明外部形势变了、为什么现在不能不改，把「敌人」指向形势而不是人
指出当初的选型是谁拍板的失误，让团队清楚认识到问题有多严重、必须由谁来负责
questions.explanation: But 负责引入冲突、制造「为什么是现在」的紧迫感，缺了它变革就像领导拍脑袋；但敌人要指向形势，否定在场者的心血会激起防御。只铺背景是「只有 and」，只给时间表是「只有 therefore」，都是常见的翻车方式。
questions.question_en: When announcing a painful architecture migration with And / But / Therefore, what should the "But" part accomplish?
options_en: Announce the migration schedule and assignments directly, so discussion doesn't slow execution
Lay out the full history and option comparisons so the team reaches the migration conclusion on its own
Show what changed in the environment and why it can't wait, casting circumstances—not people—as the enemy
Point out whose bad decision the original design was, so the team grasps how serious the problem is and who is accountable
questions.explanation_en: The But introduces the conflict that creates urgency—"why now"—without which change looks like an arbitrary order. But the enemy should be circumstances; attacking the work of people in the room triggers defensiveness. All background is the "and-only" failure; just a schedule is the "therefore-only" failure.

questions.question: 按 Nancy Duarte 的愿景叙事结构，在半年启动会上讲新方向，哪种讲法最符合？
options: 用「我带大家打下这座山」的口吻，让团队看到领导者的决心和担当
逐条讲清每一个 OKR、里程碑和架构图，保证信息完整、不遗漏任何一个重点
只描绘一年后的美好图景，避免提现状的问题打击士气
在现状之痛和一年后的可能之间来回撑开落差，团队当主角、自己当导师
questions.explanation: 愿景是一个有张力的故事：在 what is 与 what could be 之间摆动，用落差让人想动身；主角是听众，领导者是导师。只讲彼岸没有痛，没人有动力离开沙发；自己当英雄会让听众在愿景里照见不到自己；念 roadmap 信息齐全却没人记得。
questions.question_en: Following Nancy Duarte's structure for vision narratives, which approach best fits a kickoff talk on new direction?
options_en: Speak as "I'll lead you up this mountain" so the team sees the leader's resolve and ownership
Walk through every single OKR, milestone, and architecture diagram so not one important point is left out
Paint only the bright picture of a year from now, avoiding current problems so morale stays high
Swing between today's pain and what could be a year out to widen the gap, with the team as hero and yourself as mentor
questions.explanation_en: A vision is a story with tension: oscillating between what is and what could be so the gap makes people want to move; the audience is the hero and the leader the mentor. Without present pain no one leaves the couch; casting yourself as hero leaves the audience no place in the story; reading the roadmap is complete but forgettable.

questions.question: 向 VP 申请人手还技术债，只甩了一页延迟和工单数据，VP 点头后说「下季度再看」。按「数据 + 故事」的配方，最该怎么改？
options: 先讲一个具体的人在具体场景里的遭遇，再用聚合数据证明不是个案
挑一个最极端、最惨烈的个案来讲，冲击力越大，VP 就越难拒绝，也就越容易获批
补充更细的指标和同比曲线，让数据本身更有说服力
改为讲团队最近很累、士气很低，用情绪打动对方
questions.explanation: 纯数据让人理性认可但不感到痛，纯故事又像个人抱怨、撑不起决策。配方是先脸后数：一张脸让人在乎，一组数证明它不是挑出来的特例。用不具代表性的极端个案煽情短期有效，一旦被识破，可信度和以后的所有论证一起崩。
questions.question_en: You ask a VP for headcount to pay down tech debt with a page of latency and ticket data; the VP nods and says "let's revisit next quarter." Following the data-plus-story recipe, what should you change?
options_en: Open with one specific person's experience in a concrete moment, then use aggregate data to show it isn't isolated
Pick the single most extreme, harrowing case, since the bigger the shock, the harder it is for the VP to say no
Add finer-grained metrics and year-over-year charts so the data itself is more persuasive
Switch to describing how tired and demoralized the team is, to move the VP emotionally
questions.explanation_en: Pure data earns rational agreement but no felt urgency; pure story sounds like a complaint and can't support a decision. The recipe is face first, numbers second: one face makes people care, the numbers prove it isn't cherry-picked. An unrepresentative extreme case works briefly but, once exposed, sinks your credibility for every future argument.
